name: meter_grid
description: Many aligned text meters in columns, like the per core CPU meters at the top of htop.

config.name: metrics
config.label: Metrics
config.description: One meter per metric, e.g. one for every CPU core

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to display in this meter

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: The label used when the label mode is Name. Defaults to the metric name

config.name: columns
config.label: Columns
config.description: The number of meter columns. Meters fill the columns from top to bottom. Defaults to 2

config.name: column_gap
config.label: Column Gap
config.description: The space between columns in characters. Defaults to 2

config.name: label_mode
config.label: Label Mode
config.description: Index numbers the meters like htop does with CPU cores, Name uses the label or the metric name

config.name: index_offset
config.label: First Index
config.description: The number of the first meter when the label mode is Index. Defaults to 0

config.name: hide_label
config.label: Hide Labels
config.description: Hides all labels

config.name: label_width
config.label: Label Width
config.description: The width of the labels in characters. Defaults to the longest label

config.name: style
config.label: Style
config.description: htop draws pipes inside brackets with the value in the bar, btop draws squares with the value behind the bar, blocks draws a smooth bar with partial blocks

config.name: hide_value
config.label: Hide Values
config.description: Hides the formatted values

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Shows the values without their units

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places. If not set, it is chosen based on the value

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The value of a full bar. If not set, percentages use 100 and other metrics use their highest recorded value

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use a monospace font for the best result. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. The widget width decides how many characters fit

config.name: text_color
config.label: Labels
config.description: The color of the labels

config.name: value_color
config.label: Values
config.description: The color of the values

config.name: bracket_color
config.label: Brackets
config.description: The color of the brackets in the htop style

config.name: empty_color
config.label: Empty
config.description: The color of the empty squares in the btop style

config.name: background_color
config.label: Background
config.description: The background color of the widget

config.name: color_mode
config.label: Color Mode
config.description: Gradient colors every cell by its position in the bar, Threshold colors each bar by its current value, Solid always uses the low color

config.name: color
config.label: Low Color
config.description: The color of a low load

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value at which the threshold mode switches to the warning color. Defaults to 50

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of a medium load

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value at which the threshold mode switches to the critical color. Defaults to 80

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of a high load
